question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Herself**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, "**herself**" is a reflexive pronoun that refers to the subject of the sentence, which is the person being talked about (likely **Elizabeth **in this case).
 
• The use of "**herself**" indicates that the person (**she**) is actively involved in the action of stuffing into her pink tut, emphasizing a sense of **self-reference** or **self-involvement**.
 
• The reflexive pronoun "**herself**" reinforces this self-directed aspect of the action.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Oneself**" is a reflexive pronoun used when the person referred to is a general, unspecified individual.
 
• "**Himself**" is a reflexive pronoun used when the person referred to is male. It reflects the action back to the subject (him) and emphasizes that the action is performed by the same person.
 
• "**Ourselves**" is a reflexive pronoun used when the group or individuals being referred to are the same as the subject.
